_meta.purpose: Ranked story cards: one card per story, the primary source first, other outlets beneath. Built from engine entries and the legacy RegWatch archive (docs/data/items.json, read only).
_meta.ranking: regwatch_sources/classify.py rank(): band (2 in-scope primary, 1 other primary, 0 news) x 100 + score; score = type weight (legislation 85 ... supervisory communication 30; news 15), +5 open/final/in force, +2 per topic (max 10), -1 per week of age (max 20). Primary always outranks news.
_meta.news_cap: news-only cards are at most 20% of the feed; 103 lower-ranked news cards dropped this run
